extracted.name: Chocolate-Banana Tofu Pudding
extracted.description: This delightful, guilt-free tofu pudding recipe can be made in 5 minutes. It’s a dessert for everyone, vegans and chocolate lovers alike. The banana and chocolate mask the tofu.
instruction_lines: Place banana, tofu, sugar, cocoa powder, soy milk, and cinnamon into a blender. Cover, and puree until smooth.
Pour into individual serving dishes, and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.
